title: Beef Tagine with Mediterranean Flair
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew inspired by North African cuisine, featuring tender ground beef and a rich Mediterranean sauce.

ingredients.name: Mediterranean Spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the Mediterranean spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tagine paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the honey and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve over gluten-free couscous.
